The best Hanoi local delight - must try !
Aug 2017 • Family
I came across this Hanoi local food Banh Duc Nong from a Vietnam business travel blog and was captivated by the small bowl full of parsley and ingredients. I went to try for breakfast and it was a pleasant surprise to me. The Banh Duc Nong came in a small bowl and the mixed flavour of parsley, minced pork, mushroom and shallot is so delicious. I went for my second bowl. The next morning I returned and I went for two bowls again. Most Vietnamese cuisine are available in the Vietnam restaurants in our country but this is something we have never tasted before and it is really nice. For those hard core local food connoisseur , I can assure you this is a local delight that you should never miss. In fact, in the Vietnamese blogs, this stall at Le Ngoc Han street is ranked no. 1. Surprisingly this stall is not yet listed in TripAdvisor and I tell myself I have to share this amazing food with all travellers and so here is my first entry. Take a look at the photo of that little bowl of Banh Duc Nong,. Aww...Enjoy !
